title: host.update_game (platform → host)
description: SteamCMD + sync (csm update-game; with servers: csm update-server per server). Disruptive: if any target says update_safe=false the whole command is rejected match_in_progress (listing them) unless force; the platform can resend with the safe subset. Long job: host.progress. Reliable; answered by exactly one host.result (ref = this message's id). Rejected with `expired` when expires_at is past, and with `stale` when the envelope ts is more than 5 min off the host's clock (a command replayed long after it was sent is not run).
